candidates.reason: Strong right-column headline and clear CTA, but the three stacked badges (Online Only, Limited Run, New) are nearly CTA-sized and compete for attention. The jar shrinks to a tiny afterthought at the bottom left, the SOLSTICE logo is an unreadable speck, and 'Swipe up to shop' is jammed beside the CTA, wrapped into a three-line orphan.

Just a shrunk, letterboxed copy of the portrait original with huge empty side areas. The body copy, badges, logo and 'Swipe up' line are illegibly tiny and the headline is small, so it doesn't adapt to the format at all.

The jar stays prominent, but the badges are mismatched (a tiny 'Limited Run' next to an oversized 'NEW'). The 'Swipe up to shop' line sits above the CTA at body-copy size, which breaks the reading order. The rotated 'Online Only' badge floats in the lower left, the logo is crammed against the bottom edge, and the headline is undersized for the canvas.

Nearly the same as candidate 1: a dominant headline and CTA on the right, but the oversized badge stack on the left fights the message. The product jar is small, the logo is a speck, and 'Swipe up to shop' is squeezed into a three-line fragment beside the button. The badge spacing is slightly more even, which is the only reason it ranks above candidate 1.
